definition: Navigating the city's physical or social infrastructure without active BCI guidance — using memory, landmarks, and human instinct alone. Considered a survival skill in ELF-contested zones where Diaspora connectivity is jammed or hostile.
origin: Nautical terminology revived by tunnel rat communities and off-grid operatives
usage: Street samurai, tunnel rats, anti-surveillance activists, old-school fixers
example: When the ELF scorched the node grid in the Narrows, Petra ran the whole extraction on dead reckoning — three kilometers, no Diaspora, no mistakes.
